sloka: ध्वजाग्रे न्यपतद्गृध्रो विनेदुश्चाशिवं शिवाः।नयनं चास्फुरद्वामं सव्यो बाहुरकम्पत ।। ६.९६.३६ ।।
transliteration: dhvajāgre nyapatadgṛdhro vineduścāśivaṁ śivāḥ।nayanaṁ cāsphuradvāmaṁ savyo bāhurakampata ।। 6.96.36 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter as Ravana set forth for the battle, all the following forms predicting his death appeared.
